# LipSync

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("LipSync")`

Moves a character's mouth to match speech. Parent it to the `MeshPart` that has the face's morph targets and set `Source`. While a `Sound` in the `Voice` category plays under the source, the face follows it; no script is needed.

There are three methods, and each is the fallback of the one before. If the recording has a viseme track beside it (`intro_01.visemes.json` beside `intro_01.ogg`, one per language), the track is played. Otherwise the sound is analyzed in three frequency bands to tell an open mouth from a wide or a round one. A face with only a jaw target opens it by how loud the sound is.

A face map file beside the model (`hero.face.json` beside `hero.glb`) says which morph targets each viseme, band and loudness level moves. Without one, a target named `JawOpen` or `MouthOpen` is opened by loudness.

It is visual only and local to each machine, which plays the track for the voice language it hears. Its weights are applied over those a clip sets and under those a script sets with `SetMorphWeight`.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the mouth is moved. |
| `Map` | `Content` | — | read/write | The face map file, as an `asset://` path ending in `.face.json`. It says which morph targets each viseme, frequency band and loudness level moves. When empty, the file beside the model is used: the model's path with its extension replaced by `.face.json`. |
| `Mode` | `Enum.LipSyncMode` | `Enum.LipSyncMode.Auto` | read/write | Which method is used. `Auto`, the default, plays a viseme track when the line has one and otherwise falls back to analyzing the sound. |
| `Smoothing` | `number` | `0.06` | read/write | The time, in seconds, a morph target takes to reach a new weight. At 0 the mouth snaps between shapes; 0.1 is a slow mouth. |
| `Source` | `Instance?` | `nil` | read/write | The instance whose voice moves the mouth: a `Voice` sound that is this instance, or is under it, drives the face. With nil, the source is the parent of the `MeshPart`. |
| `Weight` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How strongly the mouth moves, from 0 to 2. Use 0.5 for a mumble and more than 1 for a shout. |
